When a Victorian scientist tests his revolutionary time machine, he is propelled hundreds of thousands of years into the future, only to find humanity fractured into two distinct and chilling species. Above ground live the delicate, childlike Eloi, while the subterranean Morlocks breed in darkness, using the surface dwellers as mere livestock. To escape this nightmarish underworld and return to his own era, the traveler must uncover the horrific truth behind human evolution before he becomes a victim of it himself.
